drafter.private_reasoning: No disclosure of the client's confidential authority is needed or appropriate in this NDA round. I tightened the draft to make it more internally consistent and commercially standard, while keeping it light enough to advance quickly.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Please see our proposed mark-up to the mutual NDA. We have kept the form streamlined, but clarified the scope of Confidential Information, standard exclusions, use restrictions, return/destruction mechanics, equitable relief, and governing law. We also aligned the survival period with the confidentiality obligation so there is no ambiguity between the term of the agreement and the period during which information must be protected.

Subject to your review, we think this should be close to signable.

Best,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction or business relationship and, in connection with that evaluation, may disclose or make available certain non-public, proprietary, technical, financial, commercial, operational, or other confidential information, whether disclosed orally, visually, electronically, in writing, or by any other means, including the existence and status of the parties' discussions (collectively, "Confidential Information"). Each party may act as a disclosing party or a receiving party under this Agreement.
edits.name: Purpose and Scope

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. Each receiving party shall: (a) use the disclosing party's Confidential Information solely to evaluate and negotiate the potential transaction or business relationship; (b) protect such Confidential Information using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own confidential information of similar importance, and in any event no less than reasonable care; and (c) disclose such Confidential Information only to its and its affiliates' directors, officers, employees, partners, members, advisors, financing sources, and representatives who have a need to know for the permitted purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective in substance than those contained in this Agreement. The receiving party shall be responsible for any breach of this Agreement by its representatives.
edits.name: Confidentiality Obligations

edits.text: 3. EXCLUSIONS; REQUIRED DISCLOSURE; TERM. Confidential Information does not include information that the receiving party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to the receiving party before disclosure by the disclosing party; (c) is lawfully received from a third party without restriction and without breach of any duty; or (d) is independently developed without use of or reference to the disclosing party's Confidential Information. If disclosure is required by law, regulation, court order, or governmental authority, the receiving party shall, to the extent legally permitted, provide prompt notice and reasonable cooperation so the disclosing party may seek confidential treatment or other protection. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing, and each receiving party's confidentiality and use obligations with respect to Confidential Information disclosed during that period shall survive for three years from the date of disclosure; provided that trade secrets shall be protected for so long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.
edits.name: Exclusions; Required Disclosure; Term

edits.text: 4. RETURN OR DESTRUCTION; NO LICENSE; REMEDIES; GOVERNING LAW. Upon written request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy the disclosing party's Confidential Information, except that one archival copy may be retained solely for legal, compliance, or bona fide recordkeeping purposes, and electronic backup copies need not be deleted if they remain subject to this Agreement and are not accessed except for such purposes. No license or other rights are granted by either party except the limited right to use Confidential Information as expressly permitted herein. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate, and the disclosing party may seek equitable relief, including injunction and specific performance, in addition to any other available remedies. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-laws rules.
edits.name: Return or Destruction; No License; Remedies; Governing Law
